diagnoses.label: Database connection pool exhaustion after a release
Service discovery or DNS configuration error
External dependency latency or rate limiting
Application memory leak introduced by a release
Cache hot key causing concentrated load
Queue consumer capacity or autoscaling regression
Feature flag activated an expensive query path
Host clock skew invalidating authentication tokens
Insufficient evidence; request a specific missing signal

tool_catalog.name: recent_changes
tool_catalog.description: Read deploy, configuration, certificate, and feature-flag changes.

tool_catalog.description: Read sampled service logs around the incident window.

tool_catalog.description: Read dependency latency, error, DNS, TLS, and queue health.

tool_catalog.description: Read CPU, memory, disk, connection-pool, cache, and worker metrics.

tool_catalog.description: Read the effective runtime configuration without changing it.
